# Vendored libraries

Third-party browser libraries shipped as-is. Do not edit these files; replace them with a newer upstream build instead.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|------|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| `html2canvas.min.js` | html2canvas | 1.4.1 | MIT, `LICENSE-html2canvas.txt` | https://html2canvas.hertzen.com |
| `qrcode.min.js` | QRCode.js (davidshimjs) | unknown | MIT, `LICENSE-qrcodejs.txt` | https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs |

Keep each library's license file next to it: the MIT license requires shipping its text with the code.
